notes: Company: mid-market subscription-management SaaS (billing + dunning + Zuora/Stripe integrations).
Primary buyer: VP Product (Laura Kim) + Head of Ops (Ravi Singh).
Technical champion: Staff Engineer (Noah Vega) - owns chat agent infra and webhook integration layers.
Initial ask: hosted API trial for chat-based billing support agent that can surface invoices, create prorated credits, and provide structured JSON actions for downstream systems.
Latency SLO: 95th < 300ms for streaming tokens on 2s average session; tight tail latency requirement for agent UX.
Throughput: peak ~180 concurrent agents during business hours, avg 60 qps. Cost sensitivity: careful on per-token for high volume (aim ARR ~$100k range).
Model prefs: open models (Llama variants) OK, but want Redwood-verified latency profiles. Concerned about quantization/regression on reranking when moving to Dedicated.

Tool calling: essential. Need structured function/tool-calls for: (1) fetch_invoice(invoice_id) -> JSON, (2) issue_credit(customer_id, amount, reason) -> JSON result, (3) create_refund(stripe_charge_id) -> JSON receipt.
Structured outputs: agent must return strict JSON schema (no free text) to feed their orchestration layer. Example schema requested in POC docs.
Security & compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logs per token, KMS integration for keys, optional EU data residency. Legal requested DPA and encryption-at-rest proof.
POC scope (Feb-Mar): 3-week hosted API POC with sample traffic replay (provided by NH), measure tail latency, streaming stability, and validate tool-calling JSON fidelity.
POC results so far: streaming stable, mean latency 120ms, 95p at ~290ms under 50 concurrent simulated agents. Under 180 concurrent, 95p spikes to 420ms with default config.
AE notes: demo 2026-02-10 — showed streaming + tool-calls. Quote from Laura: "We need deterministic JSON outputs or the orchestration breaks."
Security review: initial questionnaire returned 2026-02-24; SOC2 evidence requested (see SEC-447).
Pricing talks: mid-market delta — team prefers hosted for fast start; may move to Dedicated if committed throughput required and price attractive.
